Manak Sahayak — UI directions

Both use the app's real tokens (navy #1e3a8a, burnt orange #c2410c, slate ink) and real content: verified Regulation 11 text from BIS_CA_12032019.pdf p.237 and the real Air Conditioner amendment chain.

A — Institutional editorial
Reads as a standards authority, not a chatbot. IBM Plex Serif masthead, gazette-like evidence rail, verification strip above the answer.

Tradeoff: calmer, less obviously 'AI'.

B — Operator console
Shows the machinery: live retrieval scores, the 0.50 relevance floor, which retriever ran.

Tradeoff: impressive to technical judges, heavier for a first-time user.
